const {createRequire}=require('node:module');const {chromium}=createRequire('/app/package.json')('@playwright/test');const fs=require('node:fs');const out='/artifacts/performance-audit',origin='https://salient-dev.rdxx.workers.dev';
(async()=>{const browser=await chromium.launch();const {campaign}=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(out+'/fixture.json'));const records=[],network=[],frames=[],errors=[];let phase='setup';const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:1000},storageState:out+'/auth-state.json'});const page=await context.newPage();page.setDefaultTimeout(60000);
await page.addInitScript(()=>{window.__long=[];new PerformanceObserver(l=>window.__long.push(...l.getEntries().map(e=>({start:e.startTime,duration:e.duration})))).observe({type:'longtask',buffered:true});});
page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push({phase,message:e.message}));page.on('response',async r=>{if(r.url().includes('/api/auth'))return;const h=await r.allHeaders();network.push({phase,url:r.url(),status:r.status(),cache:h['cache-control'],etag:h.etag,encoding:h['content-encoding'],cf:h['cf-cache-status'],server:h.server,ray:h['cf-ray']});});
page.on('websocket',s=>{const m=new Map();s.on('framesent',({payload})=>{try{for(const x of JSON.parse(payload).modifications||[])if(x.type==='Add')m.set(x.queryId,{name:x.udfPath,start:Date.now()});}catch{}});s.on('framereceived',({payload})=>{try{for(const x of JSON.parse(payload).modifications||[])if(x.type==='QueryUpdated'){const q=m.get(x.queryId);frames.push({phase,name:q?.name,time:Date.now(),ms:q?Date.now()-q.start:null,bytes:Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(x.value??null))});}}catch{}});});
function save(){fs.writeFileSync(out+'/extra.json',JSON.stringify({records,network,frames,errors},null,2));}
async function measure(label,action,ready){phase=label;const start=Date.now();const stamp=await page.evaluate(()=>({timeOrigin:performance.timeOrigin,now:performance.now()}));await action();await ready();const elapsed=Date.now()-start;const details=await page.evaluate(()=>({now:performance.now(),timeOrigin:performance.timeOrigin,long:window.__long,paint:performance.getEntriesByType('paint').map(e=>e.toJSON()),nav:performance.getEntriesByType('navigation').map(e=>e.toJSON()),resources:performance.getEntriesByType('resource').map(e=>({name:e.name,start:e.startTime,duration:e.duration,transfer:e.transferSize,encoded:e.encodedBodySize,decoded:e.decodedBodySize}))}));records.push({label,start,elapsed,stamp,...details});console.log(JSON.stringify({label,elapsed}));save();}
for(let i=0;i<3;i++)await measure('authenticated-table-'+i,()=>page.goto(campaign+'/table'),()=>page.locator('[data-log-feed]').filter({hasText:'added to the foes roster'}).waitFor());
await page.goto(origin+'/rules');await page.locator('.rules-intro').waitFor();
for(const q of ['grab','prone','grab'])await measure('rules-search-'+q,()=>page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Search rules'}).fill(q),()=>page.waitForFunction(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.rules-list-count')?.textContent;return t&&t.includes('reference')}));
await measure('rules-open-article',()=>page.locator('a.rules-result').first().click(),()=>page.locator('.rules-prose').waitFor());
await page.goBack();await page.locator('.rules-list-count').waitFor();await measure('rules-search-after-article',()=>page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Search rules'}).fill('stamina'),()=>page.waitForFunction(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('.rules-list-count')?.textContent;return t&&t.includes('reference')}));
await measure('rules-to-foes-first',()=>page.getByRole('link',{name:'Foes library',exact:true}).click(),()=>page.locator('[data-foe-id]').first().waitFor());
await measure('foes-search',()=>page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'Search foes'}).fill('goblin'),()=>page.waitForFunction(()=>location.search.includes('goblin')&&document.querySelector('[data-foe-id]')?.textContent.toLowerCase().includes('goblin')));
await measure('foes-back-to-rules-history',()=>page.goBack(),()=>page.locator('.rules-search-box input[aria-label="Search rules"]').waitFor());
await measure('rules-to-foes-warm',()=>page.getByRole('link',{name:'Foes library',exact:true}).click(),()=>page.locator('[data-foe-id]').first().waitFor());
await measure('foes-wordmark-to-app',()=>page.locator('a.rules-wordmark').click(),()=>page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Campaigns',exact:true}).waitFor());
save();await browser.close();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
